skill.name: flux-kontext
skill.description: Guides precise single-image edits with Flux 1 Kontext Pro on RunComfy. It documents when to use the model, how to invoke the RunComfy CLI, and how to write preservation-focused edit prompts.
skill.summary: Use Flux Kontext Pro on RunComfy for precise single-image edits with strong source preservation.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting, sample prompt text, or reference links rather than executable behavior. Confirmed risks are the intentional RunComfy CLI commands and the fixed RunComfy Model API workflow, which require user consent and third-party data handling.

remediation.issue: RunComfy CLI commands can execute locally and download generated files.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the CLI, keep JSON inputs quoted, and preserve output domain and size restrictions.

remediation.issue: Users may install or run external packages to use the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Pin or document the expected RunComfy CLI package source and recommend standard package verification before global installation.

remediation.issue: Prompts and image URLs are processed by RunComfy services.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users before submission that public image URLs and edit prompts leave the local machine and should not contain sensitive data.

content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Precise image edits need clear prompts and the right model path. This skill guides Flux Kontext Pro edits through RunComfy with preservation-focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Routes explicit Flux Kontext image-edit requests to the RunComfy model workflow.
Documents the required prompt and image fields for single-image edits.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation examples for default and seeded edits.
Gives preservation-first prompt patterns for local image changes.
Explains when to choose sibling models for batch, text-heavy, or text-to-image work.
Lists common CLI exit codes and troubleshooting guidance.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and a valid token.
Supports one source image per edit request.
Sends prompts and image URLs to RunComfy for model processing.
Compound edits and multilingual text edits may need another model or multiple passes.

use_cases.title: Preserve Portrait Identity
use_cases.description: Add or adjust one visible element while keeping the face, pose, clothing, and framing stable.

use_cases.title: Update Product Labels
use_cases.description: Swap brand text or color on one product image while preserving lighting and layout.

use_cases.title: Build Repeatable Edit Flows
use_cases.description: Use seed values and concise instructions to compare controlled variants for one image.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Local Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro on this image URL: [URL]. Keep the subject, pose, and framing unchanged. Add [object] in [location].

prompt_templates.title: Product Text Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this product image with Flux Kontext Pro. Keep the product shape, lighting, and label layout unchanged. Replace only [old text] with [new text].

prompt_templates.title: Seeded Variant Pass
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a Flux Kontext Pro edit with seed [number]. Keep [protected details] unchanged and change only [target detail]. Save the result to [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Model Routing Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this image-edit request. Choose Flux Kontext Pro only if it is a single-image local edit. Explain the model choice and write the final edit instruction.

output_examples.input: A designer asks to add an orange umbrella to a portrait while keeping the person unchanged.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Flux Kontext Pro, writes a preservation-led edit instruction, and prepares one RunComfy output for the requested image.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks to apply the same edit across twelve product photos.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that Flux Kontext Pro is single-image focused and recommends a batch-capable image edit workflow instead.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a repeatable label text swap with a fixed seed.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a concise text-swap instruction, includes the seed for comparison, and notes that the image must be reachable by RunComfy.

best_practices: Start prompts with the details that must stay unchanged.
Keep each edit request focused on one clear change.
Confirm that the image URL is public and safe to send before running the CLI.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for multi-image batch edits.
Do not combine unrelated changes in one prompt when preservation matters.
Do not send private or sensitive image URLs to the remote model service.

faq.question: Does this skill edit images directly?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to run Flux Kontext Pro through the RunComfy CLI when the user approves the workflow.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: The workflow needs one edit prompt and one publicly reachable source image URL.

faq.question: Can it edit several images at once?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow is designed for one source image per request.

faq.question: Where are RunComfy credentials stored?
faq.answer: The skill documents that the RunComfy CLI can store a token under the user configuration directory with owner-only permissions.

faq.question: Does this send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI sends the prompt and image URL to RunComfy model services for processing.

faq.question: When should I use another model?
faq.answer: Use another model for batch image edits, multilingual embedded text, or image generation without a source image.
